title: Seoul to Busan by KTX First Class (2026) | Korea Bullet Train Tour 4K
description:
Escape the noise and settle into 2.5 hours of pure tranquility on the KTX from Seoul to Busan. Experience the rhythmic hum of Korea’s high-speed rail in stunning 4K, designed for deep relaxation, study, or travel dreaming. ✨🇰🇷

There is a unique magic in the transition from Seoul’s urban pulse to the serene coastal horizon of Busan. This cinematic ASMR journey captures the crisp sounds of the tracks, the soft chime of station announcements, and the ever-changing Korean landscape through the window. No talking—just the journey.

4K: Crystal clear visuals of the Gyeongbu High-Speed Line. shot on iPhone 12
Binaural Audio: High-fidelity ASMR sounds of the KTX-Sancheon/Eum.
Slow Cinema:Minimal cuts to preserve the meditative flow of travel in 2026.
Travel Prep: See exactly what the premium cabin experience looks like today.
